name: Dented Pocket Watch
flavor: Runs four minutes fast. You have learned to account for it.

name: Dead Man's Watch
flavor: Taken off a man who no longer needed the time.

name: Plated Chain
flavor: Gold for about a week, then green.

name: Party Line
flavor: Half the county listens in. Half the county buys.

name: Ghost Line
flavor: A number that was never issued, on an exchange that burned down in 1919.

name: Vest Derringer
flavor: Two shots. Mostly it is the showing that works.

name: Rusted Flivver
flavor: Forty on the flat. Thirty with a load.

name: Pasteboard Case
flavor: Holds money. Does not hold rain.

name: Clean Hands
flavor: Belonged to an alderman. Still smells faintly of his cologne.

name: Oilskin Coat
flavor: Smells like the river. Everyone on the river smells like the river.

name: Nobody's Jacket
flavor: Gray, unremarkable, the exact wrong weight for every season. No one has ever described you in it.

name: Cracked Work Boots
flavor: Resoled twice. You walk the whole route in these.
